_doc: Balto-Slavic round-4 corpora (vuk, byliny, dainos, ccmh): lemma rows (fm.load_overrides format), plus 'proto' and 'key' rows applied by pie/bsl_mapping.py at build time (a proto-form or a daughter headword whose correction reaches every word built on it). Every row cites its dictionary. See docs/research/mapping-precision-bsl-new.md.
